declarations.name: Causal.Flat.SpaceCylinder
declarations.statement: abbrev SpaceCylinder : Type := FlatQuotient (FlatQuotient.spaceGroup 0) ⊤ (ℤe₁\𝐌^{1+1}, Minkowski 1 modulo the spacelike translations by e₁ = (0, single 0 1), a circle of length 1)

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.spaceCylinder
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev spaceCylinder : Causality SpaceCylinder := flatCausality 1 SpaceCylinder
declarations.standing: definition (its flat causality, as Causal.Flat.timeCylinder). New.

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.spaceCylinder_t2Space, Causal.Flat.SpaceCylinder.instConnectedSpace, Causal.Flat.SpaceCylinder.instSecondCountableTopology
declarations.statement: T2Space SpaceCylinder; ConnectedSpace SpaceCylinder (instance); SecondCountableTopology SpaceCylinder (instance)
declarations.standing: FlatQuotient.t2Space, FlatQuotient.connectedSpace with isConnected_top, flat_secondCountableTopology_spaceGroup. T2 is a theorem (mathlib's instance already applies), the other two instances, as for the time cylinder.

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.finite_le_spaceGroup
declarations.statement: ∀ x y : (⊤ : Opens (Minkowski 1)), {γ : spaceGroup 0 | (flatCausality 1 ⊤).le ⊤ x (γ • y)}.Finite
declarations.standing: the hypothesis hfin of FlatQuotient.globallyHyperbolic_quotient, proved here as the evidence says: x ≤ y + n e₁ gives |n + y₁ − x₁| ≤ ‖(y + n e₁)₂ − x₂‖ ≤ y₀ − x₀ (PiLp.norm_apply_le), so |n| ≤ ⌈|y₁ − x₁| + (y₀ − x₀)⌉ and the set lies in the image of the finite Icc (−N) N.

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.spaceCylinder_globallyHyperbolic
declarations.standing: provides globally_hyperbolic. globallyHyperbolic_quotient (spaceGroup 0) ⊤ actsAcausally_spaceGroup (globallyHyperbolic_subtype ⊤ (minkowski_globallyHyperbolic on ⊤)) finite_le_spaceGroup. Causality comes inside it by isCausal_of_actsAcausally.

declarations.name: Causal.IsEMorphismOn.chronalCurveOn_comp
declarations.statement: IsEMorphismOn C D W φ → V ≤ W → MapsTo φ V U → C.ChronalCurveOn V c a b → D.ChronalCurveOn U (φ ∘ c) a b
declarations.standing: model-free (ETT layer) lemma, the ≪ twin of IsEMorphismOn.causalCurveOn_comp (Causal/CauchyExtension.lean:252), copied with map_lt. Stranded in a model module: a hoist candidate.

declarations.name: Causal.Causality.ChronalHomotopyOn.homotopicRel
declarations.statement: C.ChronalHomotopyOn W Γ γ₀ γ₁ → ∀ f₀ f₁ : C(unitInterval, M), (∀ s, f₀ s = γ₀ s) → (∀ s, f₁ s = γ₁ s) → f₀.HomotopicRel f₁ {0, 1}
declarations.standing: the bridge the dispatch asks for, model-free (Mathlib homotopies only). The HomotopyRel is (t, s) ↦ Γ t s on I × I, continuous by ContinuousOn.comp_continuous from the joint continuity on [0,1]²; map_zero_left/map_one_left from eqOn_zero/eqOn_one, prop' from fix_zero/fix_one. Chronality of the slices is not read. Its home would be Causal/TimelikeHomotopy.lean: a hoist candidate.

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.isLocalIsometry_mk_top, Causal.Flat.spaceCylinderMk, Causal.Flat.isEMorphism_spaceCylinderMk, Causal.Flat.spaceCylinderMk_add_int
declarations.statement: IsLocalIsometry d (fun p : Minkowski d => (⟨p, trivial⟩ : (⊤ : Opens (Minkowski d)))); spaceCylinderMk p := proj (spaceGroup 0) ⊤ ⟨p, trivial⟩; IsEMorphism (minkowski 1) spaceCylinder spaceCylinderMk; spaceCylinderMk (p + (0, n • single 0 1)) = spaceCylinderMk p for n : ℤ
declarations.standing: helpers. The local isometry is the identity in charts (g = 1, rfl); composed with isLocalIsometry_proj it is an IsEMorphism of flatCausality 1 (Minkowski 1) = minkowski 1 (flatCausality_self).

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.windLift, Causal.Flat.windCurve, Causal.Flat.windCurve_chronalCurveOn
declarations.statement: windLift k s := s • (3, k • single 0 1); windCurve k s := [windLift k s]; |k| < 3 → spaceCylinder.ChronalCurveOn ⊤ (windCurve k) 0 1
declarations.standing: the evidence's γ_k(s) = [(3s, ks)]. The lift is a timelike segment (windLift_lt :335 via minkowski_lt_top_iff and PiLp.norm_single; minkowski_chronalCurveOn_iff), pushed forward by chronalCurveOn_comp. windCurve_zero (:358): every γ_k starts at [(0,0)]; windCurve_one_int (:362): for k ∈ ℤ it ends at [(3,0)].

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.windCurve_not_chronallyHomotopicOn
declarations.statement: ∀ {m n : ℤ}, m ≠ n → ∀ W : Opens SpaceCylinder, ¬ spaceCylinder.ChronallyHomotopicOn W (windCurve m) (windCurve n)
declarations.standing: beyond the evidence (any two winding numbers, any open set). homotopicRel turns the chronal homotopy into a HomotopicRel of the two paths; IsCoveringMap.liftPath_apply_one_eq_of_homotopicRel (isCoveringMap_proj) equates the endpoints of the lifts from ⟨0, trivial⟩; eq_liftPath_iff' identifies the lifts with s ↦ ⟨windLift k s, trivial⟩, which end at (3, m e₁) and (3, n e₁); the e₁-coordinate gives m = n.

declarations.name: Causal.Flat.spaceCylinder_not_futureOneConnected
declarations.standing: the ladder node's negation, the ETT definition Causality.FutureOneConnected. γ₀ = windCurve 0 and γ₁ = windCurve 1 are future chronal curves of ⊤ from [(0,0)] to [(3,0)]; windCurve_not_chronallyHomotopicOn (0 ≠ 1) at W = ⊤.
